decisions.reason: The air quality module builds on the firm's existing sensor and firmware knowledge, so the firm can interpret its results and improve it, making a near-term drop unlikely.
As a direct replacement for an established analog input module, it is deeply embedded in the firm's core measurement knowledge and is very unlikely to be dropped.
The CAN bus interface uses the firm's communication protocol expertise and fits the modular system, so the firm can assimilate its performance data and keep it.

Although carbon dioxide sensing requires more specialized calibration, it is closely related to the air quality sensor and benefits from the firm's existing sensing capabilities, so the firm is likely to keep it.
